listing.name: Jazz Jackrabbit / OpenJazz (AlisterT)
listing.summary: Explore Jazz Jackrabbit / OpenJazz (AlisterT) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: Before first Play, copy the files from your own original Jazz Jackrabbit game into a game-data folder beside OpenJazz.exe. Keep the original source copy. The managed route selects this folder automatically. For external registration, use Change launch details to add game-data as a launch argument, or follow upstream instructions for your existing game folder. No compiler or installer is needed.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: Portcove retains game-data, openjazz.cfg, openjazz.log, the openjazz.tmp multiplayer transfer file and the reviewed scene diagnostics during compatible replacement. These are distinct from runtime files. Runtime rollback carries current declared data without rewinding progress. Custom launch paths or editions remain available through external registration.
